title: OCTAVE: A Capability-Resolved Benchmark for End-to-End HTML5 Game Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.17681v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Complete game generation requires agents to coordinate rules, interactions, states, and presentation over a long development process. A single aggregate score obscures which capabilities are implemented and which requirements remain unmet. We present OCTAVE, a benchmark for complete HTML5 game generation organized around eight Capability Dimensions, with 180 tasks and 1,800 Evaluation Requirements drawn from real player requests, commercial-mechanics reconstruction, and human expert design. It covers PC Web, Mobile Web, 2D, and 3D. Requirements distinguish Completeness, assessing publicly specified core implementation, from Richness, assessing hidden, deeper system relationships. Static source-code judgments provide requirement-level diagnosis across capabilities and task conditions. translated_title: OCTAVE：一个面向端到端HTML5游戏生成的能力分辨基准
translated_abstract: 完整的游戏生成要求智能体在漫长的开发过程中协调规则、交互、状态与呈现。单一的聚合分数会掩盖哪些能力已被实现、哪些需求仍未被满足。我们提出OCTAVE，一个以八个能力维度组织的完整HTML5游戏生成基准，包含180个任务和1,800条评估需求，这些需求来源于真实玩家请求、商业机制重建以及人类专家设计。该基准涵盖PC网页、移动网页、2D和3D场景。评估需求区分“完整性”——评估公开指定的核心实现——与“丰富度”——评估隐藏的、更深层的系统关系。基于静态源代码的判定可提供跨能力和任务条件的需求级诊断。对11种模型-框架组合的评估结果显示，完整性为33.2%，丰富度为32.5%；19.9%的生成记录属于静态门控失败或缺失。
tldr: 该论文提出OCTAVE基准，通过八个能力维度、180个任务和1,800条评估需求对端到端HTML5游戏生成进行需求级能力诊断，并揭示当前最优模型组合的完整性与丰富度仅约33%。
en_tdlr: OCTAVE is a capability-resolved benchmark with eight capability dimensions, 180 tasks, and 1,800 evaluation requirements that enables requirement-level diagnosis of end-to-end HTML5 game generation, revealing that the best model-harness combinations achieve only about 33% completeness and richness.
